_comment: Enemy models with no name entry of their own, labeled with the name of the base-game model that is the same enemy. Consumed by tools/generate_loot_massedit.py load_enemy_names(): the alias takes the target's name id, so the NpcParam variant digit (model*1000 + variant*100 + 4) still picks the variant name. Identities from the community NpcParam row names / character aliases; each checked against the game data noted.
_c6201: DLC scarabs. Same variant digits as c4191 and the same drops per digit: 62012xxx Ash of War (Ash-of-War Scarab), 62015xxx Somber Smithing Stones (Somber Scarab), 62013xxx (Glintstone Scarab).
_c5960: Ulcerated Tree Spirit (Church District, Belurat, Ellac River).
_c5800: Crucible Knight Devonia - a Crucible Knight; drops Devonia's Hammer and the Crucible Hammer-Helm.
_c6091: The Moonlight Altar turtles on Miriel's model (unnamed; Miriel himself is labeled from NpcName) - Turtle.
